title: Define binding revision and view freshness contract
objective: Define binding revision and view freshness contract; expected: reconnect resumes identity without Join.
original_acceptance: The named outcome has actual source/build-bound evidence; unsupported, pending, failed and unperformed checks remain explicit.
original_verification: Freeze the cited source decision and a bounded contract example; compare reconnect resumes identity without Join. Retain decision, alternatives and unresolved facts.
Exact executable commands: TBD at G01 and scoped prerequisite resolution; this planned procedure is not a claim that Rust/browser/provider checks ran.
decision: Resume the existing authenticated session/member reference; retain role/readiness and durable watermark; issue a fresh binding generation and require a permitted full snapshot on a new local connection. Never use Join as reconnect recovery. Fence old local connections and server bindings independently; compare durable recovery epoch/sequence lexicographically; validate a separate presentation epoch/sequence before admitting equal durable revisions.
authority: FixtureAuthority owns exactly one synthetic existing member, credential lookup, current access, binding generation and permitted projection. Its Resume response is authoritative only within this Design fixture. Client references and stamps are correlation, never credentials. Actual ConnectionViews and RpcConnection own local generation and canonical ViewStore ordering. There is no generated production Resume or BindClient service in this source.

source_boundary.retained_prior_verdict: a1 inconclusive: isolated freshness example did not observe Resume/identity/Join consumer outcome; retained unchanged, never promoted to approval
